correctness.rationale: At each bundle of k_i open-twin leaves, no LD set can omit two because their traces coincide; omitting one requires its centre selected to dominate. If no leaf is omitted the centre is arbitrary. Conversely an omitted leaf has the unique selected centre as trace and an omitted centre has a nonempty private-leaf trace, separating all outside vertices across and within bundles independently of edges of H. The three choices give local factor z^k_i(k_i+1+z), yielding complete LD polynomial, min cardinality K and ∏(k_i+1) min sets, all zeros real nonpositive. A complement D dominates iff for k_i≥2 its centre goes in D and all leaves in X; for k_i=1 one endpoint of each pendant pair is in D. Thus 2^s DLDS choices, γ(G)=n, and two-LD partitions iff all k_i=1 with 2^n ordered choices. Independent enumeration verified the polynomial and both partition counts for 74 labeled core/bundle configurations through n=3; source checker extends much farther, neither finite checker proves universal assertion.

value.rationale: The complete size generating polynomial, independence from all edges of the arbitrary core graph, and exact complementary domination/locating-partition family provide an informative structural classification beyond a routine γ value or existence theorem. The sharp condition for two locating-dominating parts isolates the obstruction created by twin leaf multiplicity and can be reused as a boundary construction. It is limited to genuinely independent degree-one private leaves.
